items.title: Charles Tolliver interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 6, 2021 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Both he and Sahib Shihab were, and, towards the end of his life as well, Ben Webster, they were all residents of Copenhagen you know.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well of course the two major venues that New York City fostered was the Cotton Club and the Savoy. You know I didn’t get a chance to see the Cotton Club although it

was still there when my family got here to New York, but it wasn’t functioning like it was in the heyday, or the earlier part of last century. And the Savoy was still there. In fact I wanted to know where that was so I kind of meandered over to where it was one day and standing out front was Idrees Sulieman. Then I was to find out later that was who I met. But you know I asked him you know is this the Savoy? And he was very nice to me, thought I was this young little kid you know, ten years old. And lo and behold…
